A separate verifier walks both buffers and compares the modeled fields, roles and extents against the pinned source trace and ODA v5.4.1.

predicateControls.knownGap: Changing the live APPID parent from 0x9 to 0xA leaves hasQualifiedDwgLayerStateAppId(0x12, ACAD) true. The predicate is a same-read APPID name/source identity proof and LAYER_CONTROL prerequisite; it does not establish APPID_CONTROL parent or membership. This observation alone is not a demonstrated exported-file failure.

limitations: Both original raw frames have scratch evidence. The production name source retains a decoded-name field, and the original adapter does not retain both raw frames and the APPID_CONTROL publication as one immutable same-read graph receipt.

The retained LAYER_CONTROL observer parses/checks fields and handle roles against its same-import publication; its current implementation permits up to seven terminal bits without checking their values. The exact terminal six one-bits are an observation of this source, not a generalized specification claim.
No MATERIAL graph admission, writer-ledger/output validation, APPID table emission, independent output readback or native consumer semantics were established. No support claim is promoted.
